li.label: intimidated
li.description: A warden reminded me that I have to obey.

li.label: coerced into obedience
li.description: I wanted to resist, but a warden forced me to back down.

li.label: defiance crushed
li.description: I was ready to defy them. They made me submit, and I hate it.

li.label: accepted discipline
li.description: I believe slavery has its place. Being disciplined still stings.

li.label: harsh discipline
li.description: My beliefs help me accept this, but being forced to obey is unpleasant.

li.label: painful submission
li.description: I accept slavery, yet having my defiance crushed was difficult to bear.

li.label: enjoyed submission
li.description: Being made to submit was strangely satisfying.
